title: DDM Update Companion (com.ecubrooks.DDMUpdateCompanion)
description: Configure DDM reminder preferences and an optional display-only simulation. Settings refresh every 60 seconds. This profile does not install the app or enforce macOS updates.

SupportURL.title: Support URL
SupportURL.description: Optional HTTPS help desk address, for example https://support.example.com. Leave empty to hide the help button. The app ignores addresses without HTTPS or a host.

CustomLogoPath.title: Custom Logo Path
CustomLogoPath.description: Optional absolute path, for example /Library/Application Support/DDMUpdateCompanion/logo.png. Deploy the image separately and make it readable by the logged-in user. Empty, missing, invalid, or oversized images (over 5 MB) use the Software Update symbol.

DisplayOnlyModeEnabled.title: Enable Display-Only Mode
DisplayOnlyModeEnabled.description: Show a clearly labeled simulated update reminder without requiring a DDM declaration. This mode never detects or enforces an operating system update. Restart the app after changing this setting.

DisplayOnlyRequiredVersion.title: Display-Only Required Version
DisplayOnlyRequiredVersion.description: Version label shown by Display-Only Mode, for example macOS 27.2. An empty value automatically suggests the next macOS version.

DisplayOnlyScenario.title: Display-Only Scenario
DisplayOnlyScenario.description: Simulated deadline scenario used only when Display-Only Mode is enabled.

DisplayOnlyDeadline.title: Display-Only Custom Deadline
DisplayOnlyDeadline.description: ISO 8601 timestamp used by the custom scenario, for example 2027-12-31T17:00:00Z. Invalid or empty values fall back to three days from launch.

PopupEnabled.title: Show Automatic Popups
PopupEnabled.description: Enable automatic popups. Manual Show Update Reminder remains available.

PopupMessage.title: Popup Message
PopupMessage.description: Plain text shown in the reminder. No template variables.
PopupMessage.default: A software update is required for your Mac.

PopupLeadDays.title: Begin Reminders Before Deadline (Days)
PopupLeadDays.description: 0 starts immediately when an update is detected; otherwise begin this many days before the deadline.

ReminderIntervalMinutes.title: Remind Later Interval (Minutes)
ReminderIntervalMinutes.description: Sets reminder interval in minutes. Used while more than 24 hours remain. At 24 hours the interval becomes 60 minutes; at eight hours it becomes 15 minutes, regardless of this value. Deferrals never cross the next timing boundary or deadline.

HideRemindLaterButton.title: Hide Remind Later Button
HideRemindLaterButton.description: Hide Remind Later button at the configured remaining-time threshold. When both days and hours fields are 0, hide it for the entire reminder.

HideRemindLaterButtonDays.title: Hide Remind Later — Days Remaining
HideRemindLaterButtonDays.description: Days in the remaining-time threshold. Combined with the hours value when Hide Remind Later Button is enabled.

HideRemindLaterButtonHours.title: Hide Remind Later — Additional Hours
HideRemindLaterButtonHours.description: Additional hours in the remaining-time threshold. Combined with the days value when Hide Remind Later Button is enabled.

HideIconWhenInactive.title: Hide Inactive Menu Bar Icon
HideIconWhenInactive.description: Hide the icon when no managed update is pending. Reopen the app to access Preferences.

HidePreferences.title: Hide Preferences Menu Item
HidePreferences.description: Hide Preferences from the menu. Command-comma still opens Preferences while the app or its menu is active. This does not restrict access to Preferences.

AllowQuit.title: Allow Quitting the App
AllowQuit.description: Turn off to grey out Quit and disable Command-Q in the app menus. Does not prevent Force Quit or system logout and shutdown.

StatusDotEnabled.title: Show Menu Bar Reminder Dot
StatusDotEnabled.description: Show a small red dot over the Software Update icon when a managed update is pending. Independent of popup timing and Remind Later.

StatusDotLeadDays.title: Begin Showing Dot Before Deadline (Days)
StatusDotLeadDays.description: 0 shows the dot immediately; 1–365 begins that many days before the deadline. Requires Show Menu Bar Reminder Dot.

StatusDotFlashHours.title: Begin Flashing Dot Before Deadline (Hours)
StatusDotFlashHours.description: Slowly flash the visible dot during the final hours and while overdue. Default: 24 hours. Set 0 for a steady dot. Reduce Motion keeps the dot steady.

LaunchAtLogin.title: Launch at Login
LaunchAtLogin.description: Register this app as a macOS login item. May require approval in System Settings. Use either this or the deployed LaunchAgent, not both.

QuietHoursEnabled.title: Enable Quiet Hours
QuietHoursEnabled.description: Pause automatic popups during the configured local-time window. Manual Show Update Reminder and the menu bar remain available.

QuietHoursStartHour.title: Quiet Hours Start (Local Hour, 0–23)
QuietHoursStartHour.description: Start hour on a 24-hour clock; 22 means 10 PM. Must differ from end hour.

QuietHoursEndHour.title: Quiet Hours End (Local Hour, 0–23)
QuietHoursEndHour.description: End hour on a 24-hour clock; 8 means 8 AM. Windows can cross midnight. Equal start and end disables quiet hours.

QuietHoursUrgentOverride.title: Allow Urgent Reminders During Quiet Hours
QuietHoursUrgentOverride.description: Allow automatic popups in the final eight hours and while overdue. PopupEnabled and PopupLeadDays still apply.
